name: server-app
title: apps/server NestJS 后端
description: Establish a current NestJS 11 / Prisma 7 server foundation with SQLite, committed migrations, template CRUD, immutable version snapshots and real HTTP integration tests.
scope: apps/server template persistence and versioning API
creator: ROYIANS
notes: The legacy Prisma 5.22 SQLite schema fails validation because that version predates SQLite Json support. Per user direction, upgrade the Server workspace to the current stable NestJS 11 / Prisma 7 / Vitest 4 stack, use Prisma 7 native SQLite Json through the core serialization contract, and deliver template CRUD/versioning. Auth, assets, datasource proxy, PDF and server-image rollout require separate contracts.
